load_evaluate_metric: load the 'regard' evaluation metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch a Gradio widget for the 'regard' evaluation metric module
run_regard_evaluation: run the 'regard' metric evaluation on text data using the Hugging Face evaluate library
